🏘️ Ethics & Safety

Proxy

In simple words

A piece of data that indirectly gives away something else, so a model can learn a bias it was never shown directly.

A piece of data that a model uses in place of something it wasn't given, because the two often go together. Removing a sensitive column, such as gender or ethnic background, doesn't make a model fair if other columns, like a postcode, can act as proxies for it.

Example. A loan model never sees anyone's background, but it does see where they live. If people from one group mostly live in certain neighbourhoods, the postcode becomes a proxy, and the old unfairness slips back in.

Related words

  • BiasWhen an AI system treats some people or groups unfairly, often because of unbalanced training data.
  • DataFacts and information a computer can store and use, such as numbers, words, pictures and clicks.
